question: You grew a small plant in a planter. On maturity, you observed that the plant has green stem, very few branches and the stem is so soft that you could easily break it with your hands. Under which category will you put this plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Herb.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The plant described has a green stem, very few branches, and a soft stem that can be easily broken, which are characteristics of a **herb**.
 
• **Herbs** are small plants with a soft stem and are usually short-lived.
 
• They do not have woody stems and are often aromatic or used for medicinal purposes.
 
• Examples of herbs include mint, basil, and parsley.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trees** are large plants with a woody stem and usually have a long lifespan.
 
• **Creepers** are plants that grow along the ground or on other surfaces by extending stems or roots.
 
• **Shrubs** are medium-sized, woody plants with multiple stems, often bushy.
 
• Knowing the characteristics of different plant categories helps in identifying and classifying plants correctly.
